headline: Groß Domestic Product Sinks test2
deck: 123 beat test2 38-34, Groß's eleven the top score in a four-point tie
body:
Groß settled it. Eleven from the midfielder led every man on the pitch, and Schade's eight behind him gave 123 the top two returns of the tie. Haaland added six. That trio alone matched most of what test2 could muster across a whole side.

test2 had Hall for eight and Trafford for a clean-sheet seven at the back, and needed his forwards to follow. They did not. Cunha's six and Isak's five were fair, but Havertz managed two and Lukić the same, and a front line built to haul delivered a middle-order.

Four points in it, and test2 will look at the bottom of his own sheet before anything 123 did. Two twos from Havertz and Lukić is the difference in a tie this tight. Groß was always going to be hard to beat; being beaten by your own attack blanking is the harder one to take.
